calculation.description: Fraction of the last 20 trading days on which the asset closed above its trailing 60-day prior high (breakout days). High values indicate sustained, repeated breakouts to multi-month highs (strong persistent uptrend); near zero indicates the asset has not challenged its range highs recently. Positive cross-sectional predictive power at 5-20d horizons with the fastest 1d IC among tested trend factors (0.020), indicating breakouts are followed by continued outperformance.

validation.regime_notes: Validated 2020-01-01..2026-07-15 on the 15-asset cross-asset universe across regimes: COVID crash 2020, recovery bull 2020-21, 2022 tightening bear, 2023-24 AI-led equity rally, 2024-26 crypto/commodity cycles. Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC, min 8 valid instruments per date. Decay: 1d 0.020, 5d 0.025, 10d 0.040, 20d 0.040.
